description: Inspect bounded file/clip XMP fields with GPS, serials, author and contact data omitted by default. Raw XMP requires include_raw and include_sensitive true; it can disclose personal data to the connected client. Distinct from Premiere-private project metadata.

include_raw.description: Opt in to raw XMP instead of parsed fields (maximum 256 Ki characters). Requires include_sensitive true; default false.

include_sensitive.description: Opt in to GPS, serial, author and contact fields; required for raw XMP; default false.

item_id.description: Node ID or name of the project item

name: get_xmp_metadata

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Get Xmp Metadata
